source_identities.role: static mathematical aggregation reference; never executed

comparison_protocol.selection: Use original one-based iResp in its stored order; experimental column 2 only. No additional selection or exclusion based on response values.
comparison_protocol.aggregation: Equal-weight arithmetic mean of the 103 selected ROI response vectors independently for each original polarity; mirrors the mathematical operation in pinned shortFlashProcessed_saveMean.m, without executing author code.
comparison_protocol.comparison: Compare original unnormalized raw fluorescence means and original time vector, with no sign inversion, rescaling, smoothing, shifts, fitting, row permutation or parameter search.
comparison_protocol.hypothesis: Test whether the unmodified source-selected mean reproduces the deposited highLum aggregate; also report the separately named lowLum comparison without selecting a preferred transform or using it as biological validation.
comparison_protocol.failure_policy: Preserve mismatches and invalid inputs; do not adjust selection, tolerance or transformation to force agreement.
comparison_protocol.exports: Hashes, membership counts, dimensions, finite checks, maximum/mean absolute differences, comparison status and resource records. Do not export individual response values or aggregate response arrays in tracked artifacts.
comparison_protocol.data_exposure: This check reads all source-selected response vectors to validate their aggregation. It is not a fit or biological holdout evaluation. Later assessment must disclose this source-validation exposure and prior published model/aggregate use of the data.
comparison_protocol.limitations: Numerical agreement links processed data products under the declared averaging operation. It does not validate microscopy preprocessing, absolute illumination, voltage or release units, population representativeness, MaleCNS transfer, whole-CNS vision or gameplay learning. Dryad CC0 does not establish licensing for the separate GitHub aggregates.

method: Only file-byte hashing and protocol parsing have occurred in this freeze command. No response arrays loaded, averaged, transformed or compared.
algorithm_details: Read original one-based iResp in stored order; require 103 unique valid rows among214.
Dereference experimental column2 only; HDF5 struct axes are[2,214], each t/rats cell[2,1], each vector[63,1].
Require all selected time vectors exactly equal to the first selected dark vector, and strictly increasing. No alignment correction is permitted.
Use NumPy float64 arithmetic mean across selected ROI axis in original order independently for dark/light; do not use SEM or trial-count weighting.
Compare both unchanged MAT meanResp[2,63] and t[1,63] with fixed absolute1e-12 tolerances; all difference metrics are absolute, no relative tolerance.
A mismatch is a completed provenance result; invalid sources or resource interruption are recorded distinctly.
